user_instruction: please reasearch for recent online streaming video point map reconstruction papers in CVPR 2026, ICLR 2026, ICML 2026.

acceptable_locations: official CVPR 2026 proceedings or accepted papers pages
CVF Open Access CVPR 2026 paper pages when available
publisher or conference-hosted paper PDFs linked from official CVPR 2026 records
official ICLR 2026 conference accepted papers pages
paper PDFs linked from official ICLR 2026 or OpenReview records
official ICML 2026 conference accepted papers pages
PMLR ICML 2026 proceedings pages when available
OpenReview ICML 2026 accepted paper records if used by the venue
paper PDFs linked from official ICML 2026, PMLR, or OpenReview records

disallowed_sources: papers outside CVPR 2026, ICLR 2026, or ICML 2026 as evidence for the requested set

non-accepted submissions, withdrawn submissions, workshop-only papers, posters without paper records, blog posts, social media posts, and project pages unless they are only used to locate an official accepted-paper record
arXiv-only versions unless the official venue record links to the same paper and the arXiv PDF is needed as an accessible copy
allowed_source_types: official supplementary material linked from accepted-paper records
official venue schedules only for confirming acceptance status

primary_concepts: dynamic or online 3D reconstruction from video
include_if: the paper proposes or evaluates online, streaming, incremental, causal, or frame-by-frame reconstruction from video
the output includes point maps, 3D point clouds, dense scene coordinates, geometry maps, or closely equivalent per-pixel/per-frame 3D map representations
the accepted venue is CVPR 2026, ICLR 2026, or ICML 2026
exclude_if: the method is only offline batch reconstruction without online or streaming operation
the paper only performs generic video understanding, SLAM localization without map reconstruction, or depth estimation without point-map-like reconstruction outputs
the paper is outside the allowed venues or lacks accepted-paper confirmation

source_scope.recency: 2026 accepted papers only, scoped to CVPR 2026, ICLR 2026, and ICML 2026

stages.name: search
stages.purpose: Find candidate accepted papers matching the topic within the allowed 2026 venues and record rejected out-of-scope leads separately.

stages.name: source_triage
stages.purpose: Verify venue acceptance, year, topic relevance, source type, and whether each candidate satisfies the online/streaming plus point-map reconstruction criteria.

stages.name: ingest
stages.purpose: Store immutable source files and parsed text for triaged in-scope papers and official metadata records.

stages.name: reader
stages.purpose: Extract structured notes from each in-scope paper, emphasizing task setting, online/streaming mechanism, point-map representation, datasets, benchmarks, metrics, limitations, and evidence strength.
stages.wiki_mutation_permissions: may create or update source notes only under wiki/sources/ for ingested in-scope sources

stages.name: wiki_update_sources_and_topics
stages.purpose: Integrate reader notes into compact durable wiki state with cited topic pages and append-only log entries.
stages.wiki_mutation_permissions: may update wiki/index.md, append wiki/log.md, update wiki/followups.md, and create or update cited topic pages under wiki/topics/

stages.name: synthesis
stages.purpose: Build a cross-paper synthesis of the in-scope CVPR 2026, ICLR 2026, and ICML 2026 papers, including trends, method taxonomy, conflicts, gaps, and a compact user-facing research map.
stages.wiki_mutation_permissions: may create or update synthesis drafts/pages only under wiki/synthesis/; all technical claims must cite wiki/sources/

stages.name: wiki_update_synthesis_and_output
stages.purpose: Preserve final synthesis state and create a durable answer artifact for the requested venue-scoped paper survey.
stages.wiki_mutation_permissions: may update wiki/index.md, append wiki/log.md, update wiki/followups.md, and create one cited durable output under wiki/outputs/

stages.name: lint_critic
stages.purpose: Audit source-scope compliance, citation coverage, wiki invariants, and whether any claims rely on disallowed or weak sources.
